publisher: Shell International (Royal Dutch Shell / Shell plc)
title: The Energy Transformation Scenarios
notes: Workbook values for 2020-2025 (all three scenarios share history to 2019). Publication month not confirmed (PDF metadata July 2021 is a later re-save).

entries.label: Waves
entries.quote: In Waves, the initial response to the crises of 2020 is to repair the economy – wealth first.
entries.subject: energy system

entries.label: Islands
entries.quote: In Islands, governments and societies decide to focus on their own security, with a new emphasis on nationalism threatening to unravel the post-war geopolitical order.
entries.subject: energy system

entries.label: Sky 1.5
entries.quote: In Sky 1.5, the initial response to the crises of 2020 is to focus on responding to the pandemic and related challenges to public well-being – health first.
entries.subject: energy system
